content: Anjali Desai sent the renewed Home Insurance policy documents (Policy #H-4521, Plan A) to Akanksha Bhatt with an annual premium of INR 12,480 payable in monthly installments starting November 5, 2025, including a 10% bundling discount. Akanksha acknowledged receipt, confirmed the terms are acceptable, and asked for clarification on the exact debit date for the first installment and the auto-debit setup method.

action_items: Clarify the exact debit date for the first monthly installment
Provide instructions on the preferred method for setting up auto-debit
